author: B. R. Mani
evidence: Buddhist monastic site at Pambarwan, Ambaran, 28 km NW of Jammu; flood-prone; abandoned around the 7th century; burning over Period III, which the excavator declines to attribute to the Hūṇas.
quote: The site seems to have been abandoned sometimes around the seventh century AD due to the above reason.
